name: Spring
source:
Spring has finally sprung, and April is excited about the new season. Help her grow a sunflower to full bloom, and let spring come alive in this visual novel!

[From [url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/spring]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
春天终于降临，艾普丽尔对崭新的季节满怀雀跃期待。在这部视觉小说中，帮她把向日葵培育至绚烂盛放，让盎然春意焕发生机吧！

[摘自[url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/spring]Itch.io[/url]]
